layout.arrangement: Centered hierarchy diagram: a black title box at top-center containing the three-line title, with four colored rectangular boxes in a horizontal row below it, connected by curved red arrows fanning out from the bottom-center of the title box to the top of each box. The whole diagram sits inside a white inner panel framed by a thin red border, which itself sits inside a larger light-gray slide area with a red outer border. A small yellow circle with the slide number '6' sits at the top-right corner of the gray area.

layout.hierarchy: The black title box with bright yellow text dominates; the four equally-sized colored domain boxes are secondary; the thin red arrows and borders are tertiary structural elements.

visual_elements.description: Simple tree/hierarchy diagram. Root node: black rectangle with yellow text 'Major Domains of Machine/Deep Learning' (three lines: 'Major Domains', 'of', 'Machine/Deep  Learning'). Four child nodes in a row, each a solid colored rectangle with white bold text: (1) blue 'Time Series', (2) green 'Computer Vision' (two lines), (3) brown/olive 'Speech', (4) dark red 'Natural Language Processing' (three lines). Four thin curved red arrows originate from the bottom-center of the black box and fan outward, each ending in a small red arrowhead at the top edge of its respective child box.
visual_elements.position: center of slide inside white panel

visual_elements.description: small circular badge, pale yellow fill with dark purple/navy outline, containing the numeral '6' in dark text

imagery: No photos or illustrations; only the diagram shapes, arrows, and the numbered circle badge.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is bold yellow on black, roughly 28-32pt equivalent, centered over three lines. Domain box labels are bold white, centered, similar or slightly smaller size. Slide number is small dark text in the badge.
animation_state: Fully built; all four boxes and arrows visible. A mouse cursor is visible just below the title box near the arrow origin.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#EDEDED) and draw a thin red (#CC0000) rectangle border inset ~5% from each edge. 2. Add a small circle at the top-right: pale yellow fill (#F5F5A0), dark outline, text '6'. 3. Draw a white rectangle with thin red border inside the gray frame, occupying roughly x 7-93%, y 22-95%. 4. Inside it, place a black rectangle centered horizontally near the top (~30-70% width); add bold yellow (#FFFF00) centered text on three lines: 'Major Domains' / 'of' / 'Machine/Deep  Learning'. 5. Below, place four equal-size rectangles in a horizontal row with even spacing: blue (#0000CC) with white bold text 'Time Series'; green (#1E8C3C) with 'Computer Vision' on two lines; brown (#7A4A00) with 'Speech'; dark red (#B30000) with 'Natural Language Processing' on three lines. 6. Draw four thin curved red (#CC0000) arrows from the bottom-center of the black box fanning out to the top-center of each colored box, with small arrowheads. 7. Center all text horizontally and vertically within their boxes.
